title: Yellowed Light Italian Bread Toast
description: A smoky and comforting Italian dish featuring white bread, perfect for a light meal or snack. This vegan-friendly recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.

ingredients.name: white bread mix
ingredients.notes: preferably Italian or French bread mix

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Mix the white bread mix according to the package instructions.
Brush the olive oil onto the bread and sprinkle with smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Place the bread onto a baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes.
Remove the bread from the oven and top with cherry tomatoes.
Return the bread to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the bread from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
